segments.text: Operationally, the worker reads its lease's expires_at on each poll and renews when under a third of the TTL remains, so a long task never runs on a lease it has already lost.
The lock is a lease, not a mutex: holding it is a time-bounded claim that expires unless actively renewed, never a permanent grant.
That means a crashed worker's work is safely reclaimable after the TTL without any manual unlock step — liveness comes from expiry, not from cleanup.
Each claim writes a row with an owner id and an expires_at timestamp; a competing worker may take over only once that timestamp is in the past.
